decision: Public alternatives checked in four targeted routes, including newly acquired eight-page 2014 Bioengineering EAP. No readable L3 target plan found; retain 329/383 without invented coordinates. The inaccessible exact Drive references and the older five-sheet emergency-plan master remain precise source gaps.
